decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that remained prominently marketed in 2024 and fits tightly with the firm's core cloud communication platform, it is a low-cost option to keep open while serving enterprise messaging use cases.

This gateway is closely related to the firm's established secure messaging offer, and for a large platform provider the cost of continuing it for another year is likely low relative to the value of learning about customer adoption.

Although still very new and somewhat more uncertain in demand, it is adjacent to the firm's core capabilities and likely inexpensive to maintain as part of a broader enterprise communications portfolio.
